Subject: Evening group demo — proposed times & breakout plan

Hi Alex / Sarah / DataForge team,

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood Inference. A few of our customers have similar architecture questions, so we thought a short multi-prospect evening session might be efficient — 30 minutes product walkthrough + 20 minutes of prospect-specific breakout rooms.

Two options we can host (all times PT):
- Tue Feb 24, 6:00–6:50pm PT (US west-friendly)
- Wed Feb 25, 8:30–9:20pm PT (APAC-friendly for partners)

Proposed plan: 30m demo (shared), then spin up 2 parallel breakout rooms (ops / infra and integration) for 20m. We'll bring a brief agenda (attached PDF) and a shared Drive folder with benchmarks.

Can you confirm which of these two slots works for your team? If neither works, tell us a couple of windows next week and we'll try to accommodate.

Bridge & calendar: attaching an .ics we will update once time is set.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0118

Attachments: multi-prospect-agenda.pdf (pdf, 120KB), evening-group-bridge.ics (calendar invite stub)

Thanks Stephanie — both slots could work for BrightAI, but a quick heads-up about priorities so we can pick:
- We're most interested in on-prem deployment patterns and SLAs for hybrid routing (latency tiers + fallbacks).
- Prefer a slightly earlier start if possible (5:30pm PT) because a couple of our engineers need to jump on an internal sync at 7:30pm.

If you can do Tue Feb 24 at 5:30–6:20pm PT, that would be ideal. If not, Wed at 8:30 is still doable. Also will you have a short technical contact in the breakouts who can deep-dive on Private (VPC) rollouts and KMS integration?

—Sarah
Sarah Kim, Head of Platform Engineering
BrightAI (sarah@brightai.io)
